hints.title: Check String Lengths
hints.text: The two strings must have identical lengths to be close.

hints.title: Match Distinct Character Sets
hints.text: Both operations preserve the exact set of distinct characters appearing in each string.

hints.title: Match Sorted Frequency Multi-Sets
hints.text: Because character identities can be exchanged, sorted lists of character occurrence counts must be identical.

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating combinations of character swaps leads to combinatorial explosion.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Counting frequencies and verifying sorted multiset equality takes O(n) time and O(k) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should deduce the necessary and sufficient invariant: same unique character set and same frequency distribution.
